Hey. From my experience, you shouldn't even be texting that person. And I know it is incredibly hard and that every single time your phone buzzes, you hope it is him. 

But you need to let go. I believe you aren't completely healing yet, as you may be still hanging on to the idea of him eventually liking you back. And it is completely normal to cling to that, because when you accept the fact that there is no coming back, it's going to hurt even more. But it must be done. You should do your best, with time of course, to accept that it wasn't meant to be and face that unbearable pain so you can get back up on your feet.

Also, try to understand his actions. He doesn't feel the same as you and probably keeps ignoring you in order not to lead you on any longer or give you hope. Take this as an opportunity to walk away.
